items.en: Patrick Stewart, 'Star Trek' Captain Picard and 'X-Men' actor, dies at 86
items.zh: **英國演員 Patrick Stewart 逝世，享壽 86 歲**：以《星際爭霸戰》Picard 艦長與《X 戰警》Professor X 聞名，是跨越莎劇舞台與好萊塢的少數演員。
items.summary: Sir Patrick Stewart, the British actor best known as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation and Professor Charles Xavier in the X-Men films, has died at 86. Al Jazeera reported the death on 29 October 2026. Stewart began at the Royal Shakespeare Company and spent decades in classical theatre before television made him globally famous in 1987. He returned to the Picard role in the 2020s series Picard, and was knighted in 2010. He was also known for his activism on domestic violence and for his friendship with Ian McKellen.

items.en: Israel election result shows no overall majority as vote count completes
items.zh: **以色列大選計票完成，無任何陣營過半**：組閣談判將拉長，而猶太裔政黨公開拒絕巴勒斯坦政黨支持，使僵局更難化解。
items.summary: Israel's final election count, completed on 29 October 2026, leaves no bloc with a governing majority, setting up prolonged coalition talks. Al Jazeera also reported that Jewish Israeli blocs are refusing to rely on support from Palestinian-led parties, with one report headlined on the view that the 'Arab voice doesn't count'. That stance narrows the arithmetic further, because without those seats neither of the main blocs can easily reach 61. The result arrives while Israeli strikes continue in Gaza and the Health Ministry presses for the Rafah crossing to reopen, so a caretaker government may handle those decisions.

items.en: Five days to US midterms: Obama and Trump trade blows at rallies in Georgia and Ohio
items.zh: **美國期中選舉倒數五天**：歐巴馬與川普分別在喬治亞與俄亥俄造勢，交火焦點是伊朗戰爭、關稅與白宮舞廳工程。
items.summary: With five days until the 3 November US midterms, Al Jazeera reported duelling rallies: Barack Obama in Georgia and Donald Trump in Ohio, trading attacks over the Iran war, tariffs and the White House ballroom project. A separate poll round-up weighed the state of the race as Trump and Kamala Harris campaign. The coverage also notes concern among Muslim American voters after what Al Jazeera described as hate attacks targeting candidate Abdul El-Sayed, with community members saying they remain resilient. Control of Congress, and therefore oversight of war spending, is the stake.

items.en: Pentagon says the Iran war has cost US taxpayers $47bn
items.zh: **五角大廈：對伊朗戰爭已花掉美國納稅人 470 億美元**：這個數字在期中選舉前五天公布，直接變成選戰議題。
items.summary: The Pentagon has put the cost of the Iran war to US taxpayers at $47bn, a figure Al Jazeera examined on 29 October 2026 for what it means politically and militarily. The timing matters: the number landed five days before the midterms, giving both parties a concrete figure to campaign on. Related coverage the same day included what is known of a letter from Vice President JD Vance to Rezaei, and a warning from Trump telling Gulf states to 'prepare'. Al Jazeera's live blog also tracked a reported seven-day Hormuz plan pressed by Tehran.

items.en: Houthis again target Riyadh; coalition says two missiles intercepted
items.zh: **胡塞武裝再度攻擊利雅德，聯軍稱攔下兩枚飛彈**：戰線已從荷莫茲海峽擴散到沙烏地首都，是油價留在 100 美元之上的主因。
items.summary: Saudi-led coalition forces said they intercepted two Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh, according to Al Jazeera's Iran war live blog on 29 October 2026. The same blog reported Tehran pressing a seven-day Hormuz plan while Trump denied peace talks were under way. The widening of the conflict from the Gulf waterway to the Saudi capital is the clearest sign yet that the war is not contained, and it is the main reason WTI crude sat near $102 a barrel at the US close on 29 October. For Taiwan, that feeds directly into shipping and petrochemical input costs.

items.en: Alphabet suffers its worst trading day since its 2004 IPO, erasing nearly $500bn
items.zh: **Alphabet 單日暴跌約 12–13%，是 2004 年上市以來最慘一天**：市值蒸發近 5,000 億美元，起因是搜尋廣告成長放緩與自由現金流轉負。
items.summary: Alphabet shares fell roughly 12-13% on 29 October 2026, the steepest one-day drop since its 2004 IPO, wiping out close to $500bn in market value. The company missed revenue and profit expectations, reported a sharp slowdown in core search advertising growth, and posted negative free cash flow of about $9.1bn. Capital expenditure came in at $51.36bn, below the $55.09bn analysts expected. Analysts framed the reaction as a regime change: markets are no longer rewarding companies simply for spending heavily on AI, and now want to see the return on that spending.

items.en: South Korea fines Apple $15m and orders an App Store payment and review overhaul
items.zh: **南韓對 Apple 開罰 1,500 萬美元，並要求改造 App Store 付款與審查制度**：這是繼歐盟後第二個實質撬開 iOS 付款封閉性的主要市場。
items.summary: South Korean regulators fined Apple about $15m and ordered the company to overhaul App Store payment and app review policies, MacDailyNews reported on 29 October 2026. The order follows South Korea's earlier legislation requiring app stores to permit alternative payment systems, and is the second major jurisdiction after the European Union to force structural change rather than impose a one-off penalty. The fine itself is immaterial to Apple's finances; the review and payment requirements are what matter, because they set a template other regulators in Asia can copy.

items.en: Apple ships iOS 27.2 with fixes for 163 vulnerabilities, including a critical WebKit RCE
items.zh: **Apple 推出 iOS 27.2，修補 163 個漏洞**：其中一個是 WebKit 的遠端程式碼執行高風險漏洞——只要開到惡意網頁就可能被利用，建議立刻更新。
items.summary: Apple released iOS 27.2 with patches for 163 vulnerabilities, among them a critical remote code execution flaw in WebKit, according to CyberSecurityNews. A WebKit RCE is the most serious class of mobile bug for ordinary users, because WebKit renders web content across Safari and any in-app browser, so merely loading a crafted page can be enough to trigger it. The practical advice is to install the update rather than defer it. Separately, Samsung pushed its October 2026 security update to Galaxy Watch 9 devices the same day.

items.en: Milwaukee Brewers win the first World Series title in franchise history, beating Tampa Bay 4-1 in Game 5
items.zh: **密爾瓦基釀酒人隊首度奪下世界大賽冠軍**：10/28 第五戰以 4-1 擊敗坦帕灣光芒，系列賽 4 勝 1 敗，結束球團 57 年的等待。
items.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers won the 2026 World Series on 28 October 2026, beating the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 in Game 5 to take the series in five games. It is the first championship in the franchise's history, which dates to 1969. CNN and MLB both led with the result. The Brewers had never won a title in either league, having lost their only previous World Series appearance in 1982. For Taiwanese viewers the series ran in morning slots, and the clincher closed out the MLB season a day before the Taiwan market's sharp pullback.

items.en: NBA: Houston and Dallas record the night's biggest blowouts in a 12-game slate
items.zh: **NBA 10/28 一口氣打了 12 場**：火箭 132-100 大勝公鹿、獨行俠 120-96 痛擊雷霆，湖人也以 103-87 在同城德比贏下快艇。
items.summary: The NBA played a 12-game slate on 28 October 2026. The largest margins came from Houston, who beat Milwaukee 132-100, and Dallas, who beat Oklahoma City 120-96. The Los Angeles Lakers took the city derby 103-87 over the Clippers. Other results: Miami 129-117 Atlanta, New York 133-127 Chicago, Cleveland 121-111 Washington, Detroit 97-89 Charlotte, Philadelphia 114-109 Indiana, Golden State 119-114 Minnesota, Denver 104-91 New Orleans, Toronto 129-99 Orlando, and San Antonio 117-111 Utah in overtime. Games on 29 October tipped off after Taiwan's overnight hours.

items.en: NHL: Carolina own the league's best record a month into the season, Vancouver the worst
items.zh: **NHL 開季約一個月的戰績分布已經很極端**：卡羅萊納 10 勝 2 敗 2 延敗領先全聯盟，溫哥華 3 勝 10 敗 1 延敗墊底。
items.summary: Records entering the 29 October 2026 NHL schedule showed Carolina at 10-2-2, the best mark in the league, with Boston 9-3-1 and Minnesota 9-3-2 close behind. At the other end Vancouver stood 3-10-1 and Los Angeles 3-6-2. Eleven games were scheduled for 29 October, including Boston at St Louis, Montreal at Dallas and Ottawa at Los Angeles, all starting between 19:00 and 22:00 US Eastern time, which is the small hours of 30 October in Taiwan, so final scores were not yet available when this brief was compiled.

items.en: Pooled GCC data: about half of Gulf university students report depression, anxiety or stress symptoms
items.zh: **海灣六國大學生心理健康統合分析**：46 篇研究、2.46 萬名學生，憂鬱約 48%、焦慮約 53%；未滿 21 歲者焦慮比例高達 61%。
items.summary: A review in BMC Psychiatry pooled 46 studies covering more than 24,600 university students across the six Gulf Cooperation Council states, published between 2010 and 2025. Pooled prevalence was about 48% for depression, 53% for anxiety and a similar share for stress. In the UAE subset the figures were 46.8%, 56.2% and 57.1%. Female students reported more symptoms than male students, 54% versus 47% for anxiety, and students under 21 reported 61% anxiety against 47% for older peers. Medical and dental students reported the highest stress. These are screening questionnaires, not clinical diagnoses.

items.en: How you use the phone matters more than how long: 'heavy process' users scored worse on memory and attention
items.zh: **滑手機傷不傷記憶，關鍵不是時數而是用法**：225 名大學生中，每天 5 小時以上「被動刷內容」的那組，記憶與注意力測驗表現最差、睡眠最糟。
items.summary: Researchers at Semmelweis University in Budapest surveyed 225 Hungarian university students aged 18 to 34 and published the results in Acta Psychologica. They sorted participants into three groups: 'pure social' users who mainly message, 'light process' users under roughly five hours a day, and 'heavy process' users, about a third of the sample, who spent five hours or more mostly consuming content. The heavy group scored worst on memory and attention tasks, reported the poorest sleep, and showed the highest fear of missing out and lowest self-control. It is survey data, so association rather than proof of cause.

items.en: Ten minutes of daily moderate exercise was linked to deeper non-REM sleep and better next-day mood
items.zh: **每天只要 10 分鐘中強度運動，就和更深的非 REM 睡眠有關**：關鍵是「天數」而不是總時數，週末一次補足的效果不如每天動一點。
items.summary: A University of Texas at Austin study in the Journal of Physical Activity and Health tracked students wearing Fitbit devices for several months, analysing activity against sleep architecture and next-day mood. People who exercised on more days got more deep, restorative non-REM sleep, and about ten minutes a day of moderate-to-vigorous activity, roughly a 6 on a 1-10 exertion scale, was enough to show the association. Walking and standing breaks also tracked with healthier sleep and better mood. The design is observational, and the authors say a larger cohort is needed to test whether daily beats 'weekend warrior' patterns.
items.source: Journal of Physical Activity & Health／ScienceDaily（10/29 頁面）

items.en: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon for sustained engineering and cybersecurity work, but keeps it locked down
items.zh: **Google 發表 Gemini 4 Carbon**：主打長時間工程與資安任務，自稱在 SEC-bench Pro 拿到 88.2%、情報指數 59 居首——但一般開發者與消費者都還拿不到。
items.summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, a model aimed at sustained engineering and cybersecurity work. Google's own figures put it at 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro and 71% on CWE-bench, and top of the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 at 59. Access is deliberately narrow: selected cyber defenders get early access, then trusted partners through a programme called Fairwind, with no consumer or general developer availability yet. Google says it is participating in voluntary US government testing before wider release. All benchmark claims are the vendor's and have not been independently verified.

items.en: Anthropic adds ready-made legal review artifacts to Claude; OpenAI stands up an election monitoring centre
items.zh: **Claude 新增法務審閱的現成 artifact**（合約審查、引註查核、法規追蹤）；**OpenAI 則為 11/3 美國期中選舉設立數百人的選舉監控中心**，同時面臨一起過失致死訴訟。
items.summary: Anthropic introduced ready-made legal review artifacts in Claude for contract review, citation checking and tracking regulatory changes. OpenAI set up an election monitoring centre staffed by hundreds of people to watch for suspected misuse of ChatGPT around the 3 November US midterms, added iCloud Mail and Calendar plugins, and expanded its ServiceNow partnership. OpenAI also faces a wrongful death suit alleging GPT-4o helped a young woman taper off epilepsy medication; the company called the case heartbreaking and said that model is no longer available. The allegations have not been adjudicated.

items.en: Samsung posts record revenue but misses on profit, and hyperscaler capex comes in light; chip stocks fall
items.zh: **三星營收創新高、獲利卻不如預期，加上微軟與 Alphabet 資本支出都低於市場估計**：記憶體與 AI 基建族群同步下殺，這正是昨天台股聯電跌停、AI 股回檔的上游原因。
items.summary: Samsung's September-quarter net profit rose more than sixfold to 75.14tn won but missed the 86.13tn won consensus, even as revenue more than doubled to a record 195.25tn won. At the same time Microsoft's capital expenditure came in at $45.2bn against a $50.7bn estimate, and Alphabet's at $51.36bn against $55.09bn. Lower hyperscaler spending reads as a negative for AI infrastructure suppliers, and chip names fell: Micron about 3.4%, Intel 3.3%, Broadcom and AMD about 2.8% each, and the SOXX semiconductor ETF 2.5%. Intel then fell about 17% at the close on a weak Q4 revenue outlook.

items.en: Quantum spin-off hardware and an AI chip smuggling seizure: PsiQuantum's optical switch, Malaysia's $12m haul
items.zh: **量子公司 PsiQuantum 把量子研究做成 8x8 光訊號交換器**，用來在 AI 處理器之間更有效率地導光；**馬來西亞則在機場查獲藏在 30 台伺服器內、價值逾 1,200 萬美元的先進 AI 晶片。**
items.summary: PsiQuantum demonstrated an 8x8 optical signal switch derived from its quantum photonics research, which routes light between AI processors more efficiently, and is sampling it to prospective customers; it is a reminder that quantum programmes can yield sellable classical hardware long before a useful quantum computer exists. Separately, Malaysian authorities seized advanced AI chips worth more than $12m hidden inside 30 servers at Kuala Lumpur International Airport, suspecting the country was a transit point for evading export controls. The final destination has not been disclosed. NVIDIA also released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe as a free open-weight speech-to-text model.

items.en: DEADLINE TOMORROW 13:00: Kenshi Yonezu Taipei Dome name-registered lottery closes 10/31 at 13:00
items.summary: The name-registered lottery for Kenshi Yonezu's GHOST world tour at the Taipei Dome closes at 13:00 on Saturday 31 October 2026, having opened at 13:00 on 29 October on the Ticket Plus platform. The two shows are Saturday 26 and Sunday 27 December, doors 15:00 and showtime 18:00, and this is his first Taipei Dome appearance. Results are announced by email and SMS at 12:00 on Monday 2 November, with payment due by 13:00 on Tuesday 3 November. Prices run NT$1,800 to NT$5,980, accessible seats NT$2,840 and NT$2,240. Two tickets per account per show, name-registered and non-transferable.

items.en: Vaundy plays Taipei Arena tomorrow and Sunday on the ASIA ARENA TOUR 'HORO'
items.zh: **Vaundy 明天就在台北小巨蛋開唱**：《ASIA ARENA TOUR 2026「HORO」in TAIPEI》**10/31（六）、11/01（日）連兩天**，實名制抽選早在 5 月就完成。
items.summary: Vaundy performs at the Taipei Arena on Saturday 31 October and Sunday 1 November 2026 on his ASIA ARENA TOUR 2026 'HORO', his first Taipei Arena headline run, confirmed back in February. The Taipei Arena's own event page lists both dates as publicly ticketed. Ticketing ran through a Ticket Plus name-registered lottery that opened on 13 May and closed on 17 May, so there is no general on-sale left. Weather for the weekend looks cooperative: the northeast monsoon eases during Saturday, leaving mostly cloudy to sunny skies in northern Taiwan with highs around 25-27C.
items.source: 臺北小巨蛋官網／中時（10/31–11/01 場次）

items.en: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour hits Kaohsiung National Stadium on the same night as Vaundy
items.zh: **藤井風 10/31 高雄世運主場館開唱，和 Vaundy 台北場正面撞期**：粉絲在社群上討論「要怎麼分身」，南北兩場同一晚只能選一邊。
items.summary: Fujii Kaze brings the Prema World Tour to Kaohsiung National Stadium on Saturday 31 October 2026, the same night Vaundy opens at the Taipei Arena, a clash NOWnews reported fans joking about. The Kaohsiung venue is the 2009 World Games main stadium, an open-air site, so the weather matters: forecasts have the northeast monsoon weakening during Saturday with southern Taiwan mostly cloudy to sunny and highs near 28-30C, lows 20-23C. For anyone in Tainan this is the geographically easy one of the two, roughly 40 minutes by train rather than a trip to Taipei.

Taiwan dates already played this year include Yuuri at the Taipei Arena on 9-10 October, which sold out, and King Gnu, LiSA and back number earlier in 2026.

items.zh: **清單內尚未舉行的台／港／日場次整理**：tuki. 首次亞洲巡演台北場（4/4–4/5）、YUIKA 第二次亞巡台北場（5/30–5/31）——兩筆都還沒公布詳細場館與票價。

Watch for Ticket Plus and KKTIX announcements, since the Taiwan market has shifted almost entirely to name-registered lotteries for Japanese acts, meaning registration windows matter more than on-sale speed.

market.asOf: ★ **台股＝2026/10/29（四）13:30 收盤**（前一交易日）；**美股＝美東 2026/10/29（四）16:00 收盤**（台灣時間今天凌晨 04:00）。　★ **關鍵順序（昨天一天內發生三件事）**：**①美東 10/28 深夜 FOMC 維持利率 3.75%–4.00% 不變（兩位委員投票主張升息）** → **②台股 10/29 開盤本該偏多，卻反向下殺，盤中最低 46,055.07、終場跌 667.25 點** → **③美東 10/29 盤中 Alphabet 財報引爆「AI 資本支出報酬率」質疑，單日暴跌 12–13%、那斯達克跌 1.38%**。　⚠️ **也就是說：台股昨天的下跌發生在 Alphabet 暴跌之前，今天開盤才要面對那一段。**
market.highlight: **一句話：昨天台股跌 667.25 點、-1.42% 收 46,368.33，一天就把前一天的 939 點漲幅吐掉七成，並同時失守 5 日、10 日與 60 日（季）線——而且這是在美股上漲、Fed 維持利率不變的背景下跌的。** 真正的壓力來源在個股：**聯電法說會後爆量跌停收 115.5 元，被外資單日砍 12.92 萬張，是外資賣超榜首**；外資及陸資全日賣超 688.15 億元、三大法人合計賣超 816.66 億元。**但這還不是最糟的消息**：台股收盤後，美股在 10/29 盤中因 **Alphabet 財報（營收獲利雙缺、自由現金流轉負 91 億美元、資本支出低於預期）單日崩跌 12–13%、市值蒸發近 5,000 億美元，是 2004 年上市以來最慘一天**；**ServiceNow -25%、Fortinet -21%、Intel -17%**，那斯達克收 26,184.73、-1.38%。**兩天合起來的訊息很清楚：市場已經從「誰敢花錢做 AI 就給獎勵」，切換成「花了錢的要先拿出報酬」——而台股的 AI 伺服器、PCB、記憶體族群，整條鏈都站在「花錢的那一端」。**
market.note: ★ **開盤前只需要記住這六件事**：　**①昨天跌的不是指數而是「權值股與千金股」**：台積電跌 10 元收 2,415、聯發科跌約 4% 收 4,045、聯電跌停、廣達與台達電跌約 3–4%、大立光跌約 8%、信驊跌 315 元收 16,980。**金融股反而漲（金融類股 +1.05%，第一金 +3%，彰銀／兆豐／華南各約 +1%）——這是教科書式的「資金從成長股撤往防禦股」。**　**②量增下跌是警訊**：成交值 7,891.52 億，比前一天的 7,221.35 億**多了 670 億**。前天是「量縮上漲」、昨天是「量增下跌」，**連續兩天的量價都站在空方。**　**③聯電跌停是「法說會後的事實修正」，不是情緒**：Q3 EPS 1.32 元，稅後淨利季減 61.1%（營業利益季增 24.7%，主要是前一季有業外收益墊高基期）。**這種跌停通常不會一天結束，要看今天有沒有再見到 9,038 張那樣的高掛賣單。**　**④技術面**：加權同時失守 5 日、10 日、60 日線，**60 日季線的得失是接下來一週的主戰場**；46,055 是昨天的低點，**但「一天的低點」不等於支撐。**　**⑤今天開盤要面對昨晚美股的 Alphabet 利空**：Alphabet 與微軟的資本支出都低於市場估計（微軟 452 億 vs 507 億估計、Alphabet 513.6 億 vs 550.9 億估計），**而台灣的 AI 伺服器、CCL、散熱、記憶體族群的訂單能見度就建立在這些資本支出上**——**這是今天最需要盯的單一變數。**　**⑥唯一的好消息是輪動還在**：昨天仍有 7 檔上市股逆勢漲停（同泰、智原、東訊、科妍、佳世達、台端、麗臺），櫃買的穩懋也鎖漲停，**代表資金沒有離開台股，只是從大型 AI 股換到中小型題材股與金融股。**　★ **投信昨天逆勢買超 86.49 億元，且買超前十名有五檔是金融股**（台新新光金、中信金、彰銀、兆豐金、永豐金）——**內資法人的方向和外資相反，這是今天盤中值得觀察的分歧。**
